correctness.rationale: For each coordinate the sign sum is C_n−2U_i, where U_i is the up-step count. In the adjacent swap at positions 2j,2j+1, the preceding height is odd and hence at least one, so the 10↔01 pairs preserve nonnegativity. At positions 2j−1,2j, the only unpaired contribution to U_(2j−1)−U_(2j) is 10 at height zero; its prefix and suffix are arbitrary Dyck paths of sizes j−1 and n−j. The resulting positive increments telescope from U_1=C_n. The increments are symmetric in j. At even n=2m the cumulative value hits C_n/2 at m only, giving the two plateau coordinates n,n+1; the neighboring increments give gap 2C_(m−1)C_m. At odd n=2m+1 the unique central increment is C_m², giving central values with opposite signs and minimum magnitude C_m². This includes n=1.

evidence: In the earlier combinatorial first-return decomposition UADB, the mark is U, in A, or in B, giving terms yC(y)^2, xyC(y)F and x²C(x)F. Thus before reducing coefficients, F=yC(y)^2/(1−xyC(y)−x²C(x)), where C(z)=1+z²C(z)^2.

The same multiplication as for the displayed mod-two identity, with signs restored, yields (x−y)F=xyC(x)C(y)+1−C(y): multiply the right side by 1−xyC(y)−x²C(x), use C(x)(1−x²C(x))=1 and 1−C(y)=−y²C(y)^2, and obtain (x−y)yC(y)^2.
For interior t, [x^t y^(2n−t)](x−y)F is N_(n,t−1)−N_(n,t). The right-hand side gives C_(j−1)C_(n−j) for t=2j−1, zero for positive even t, and the endpoint t=0 gives −C_n.
